mapper.sql: diet_id, user_id, meal_type, eaten_at, memo, total_calories, total_protein_g, total_carbs_g, total_fat_g, total_sugar_g, total_sodium_mg, total_fiber_g, total_iron_mg, total_phosphorus_mg, total_potassium_mg, total_vitamin_a_ug_rae, total_beta_carotene_ug, total_retinol_ug, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT di.diet_item_id, di.diet_id, di.food_id, f.name AS food_name, f.brand, di.input_amount, di.input_unit, di.amount_g, di.amount_ml, di.calories, di.protein_g, di.carbs_g, di.fat_g, di.sugar_g, di.sodium_mg FROM diet_items di JOIN foods f ON f.food_id = di.food_id WHERE di.diet_id = #{dietId} ORDER BY di.diet_item_id ASC
SELECT target_calories, target_protein_g, target_carbs_g, target_fat_g FROM health_profiles WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diets ( user_id, meal_type, eaten_at, memo, total_calories, total_protein_g, total_carbs_g, total_fat_g, total_sugar_g, total_sodium_mg, total_fiber_g, total_iron_mg, total_phosphorus_mg, total_potassium_mg, total_vitamin_a_ug_rae, total_beta_carotene_ug, total_retinol_ug ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{mealType}, #{eatenAt}, #{memo}, #{totalCalories}, #{totalProteinG}, #{totalCarbsG}, #{totalFatG}, #{totalSugarG}, #{totalSodiumMg}, #{totalFiberG}, #{totalIronMg}, #{totalPhosphorusMg}, #{totalPotassiumMg}, #{totalVitaminAUgRae}, #{totalBetaCaroteneUg}, #{totalRetinolUg} )

INSERT INTO diet_items ( diet_id, food_id, input_amount, input_unit, amount_g, amount_ml, calories, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, sugar_g, sodium_mg, fiber_g, iron_mg, phosphorus_mg, potassium_mg, vitamin_a_ug_rae, beta_carotene_ug, retinol_ug ) VALUES ( #{dietId}, #{foodId}, #{inputAmount}, #{inputUnit}, #{amountG}, #{amountMl}, #{calories}, #{proteinG}, #{carbsG}, #{fatG}, #{sugarG}, #{sodiumMg}, #{fiberG}, #{ironMg}, #{phosphorusMg}, #{potassiumMg}, #{vitaminAUgRae}, #{betaCaroteneUg}, #{retinolUg} )
mapper.update: UPDATE diets SET meal_type = #{mealType}, eaten_at = #{eatenAt}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE diet_id = #{dietId} AND user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE diets SET total_calories = #{totalCalories}, total_protein_g = #{totalProteinG}, total_carbs_g = #{totalCarbsG}, total_fat_g = #{totalFatG}, total_sugar_g = #{totalSugarG}, total_sodium_mg = #{totalSodiumMg}, total_fiber_g = #{totalFiberG}, total_iron_mg = #{totalIronMg}, total_phosphorus_mg = #{totalPhosphorusMg}, total_potassium_mg = #{totalPotassiumMg}, total_vitamin_a_ug_rae = #{totalVitaminAUgRae}, total_beta_carotene_ug = #{totalBetaCaroteneUg}, total_retinol_ug = #{totalRetinolUg}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE diet_id = #{dietId} AND user_id = #{userId}
